title: Steps: Custom colors (daisyUI)
notes:
Steps can be used to show a list of steps in a process.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/steps/+page.md
code:
• Fly to moon
  • Shrink the moon
  • Grab the moon
  • Sit on toilet
